desc: Derive the exact feasibility characterization: \(R\) must be even; mixed cases require \(R\ge2\) and \(B\ge1\); pure red requires positive even \(R\); pure blue requires positive even \(B\).
Find explicit geometric constructions for mixed cases and monochromatic cycles.
Implement the all-blue transformed-coordinate rectangle construction.
Integrate mixed triangular and quadrilateral bases with same-color edge expansion.
Add independent validation of piece counts, coordinate bounds, uniqueness, cyclic closure, and move legality.
Semantically exhaustively validate every small feasible and infeasible pair.
Stress-test mixed expansions and monochromatic constructions at maximum permitted counts.
Verify output formatting and total runtime for \(\sum(R+B)\le2\times10^5\).
Resolve the reported sample mismatch by distinguishing exact-output comparison from a genuine constructive failure.
